Part 1: Regulatory Context & Framework

Federal Reserve SR 11-7: Guidance on Model Risk Management

Core Requirements:

  1. Model Development: Conceptual soundness, proper model design
  2. Model Validation: Independent review, ongoing monitoring
  3. Model Governance: Policies, controls, documentation

Key Requirements for Credit Risk Models:

  • Transparent methodology that can be explained to regulators
  • Auditability and reproducibility of all decisions
  • Bias/fairness testing across protected classes
  • Ongoing monitoring and performance tracking
  • Complete documentation for regulatory submission

Part 3: Fair Lending Compliance Analysis (ECOA)

Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA) Requirements

Prohibited Bases for Credit Decisions:

  • Race, Color, Religion, National Origin
  • Sex, Marital Status
  • Age (except when age directly correlates with creditworthiness)
  • Public Assistance Receipt

Regulatory Obligations:

  • Adverse action notices must include specific reasons for denial
  • Model must not discriminate on prohibited bases
  • Regular monitoring and disparity testing required
  • Four-fifths rule: Approval rate for any group should be ≥ 80% of highest group

Part 4: Adverse Action Explanations (ECOA Requirement)

ECOA Regulation B Requirements

When a credit application is denied, the creditor must provide:

  • Specific reasons for the adverse action
  • Principal factors that led to the decision (ranked by importance)
  • Notice of rights under ECOA

Sample Adverse Action Explanation

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ ADVERSE ACTION NOTICE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ Application Details: Application ID: #001 Decision: DENIED Default Probability: 86.5% Decision Date: 2026-05-25 Applicant Profile: Duration: 47 months Credit Amount: $14,160 Installment Rate: 4 Age: 43 years ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ PRINCIPAL REASONS FOR ADVERSE ACTION (Listed in order of impact on decision) ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 1. High Credit Amount Amount Requested: $14,160 Risk Factor: Large loan amounts show higher default rates Pattern Impact: -0.996 coefficient Suggestion: Consider reducing loan amount to under $8,000 to improve approval probability 2. Extended Loan Duration Duration: 47 months Risk Factor: Long repayment periods increase default risk Suggestion: Shorten loan duration to 24 months or less 3. High Installment Rate Rate: 4 (high) Risk Factor: High monthly payment burden relative to income Pattern Impact: -0.905 coefficient Suggestion: Increase down payment to lower monthly installments ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ RECOMMENDED ACTIONS TO IMPROVE APPROVAL CHANCES ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ • Reduce loan amount to under $8,000 • Shorten loan duration to 24 months or less • Lower installment rate through larger down payment • Improve checking account balance • Consider a co-signer with strong credit history ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ YOUR RIGHTS UNDER THE EQUAL CREDIT OPPORTUNITY ACT ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ You have the right to: • Request specific reasons for this decision within 60 days • File a complaint with federal regulatory agencies • Review your credit report and dispute any inaccuracies For questions about this decision, please contact our Fair Lending Office during business hours.

Understanding Feature Codes

UCI German Credit Dataset - Categorical Feature Codes

The German Credit dataset uses encoded categorical variables where each "A" code represents a specific category. Below is a complete reference guide for interpreting pattern codes.

Key Codes in Top Patterns

CodeFeatureMeaningRisk Indication
A41PurposeCar (used)✓ POSITIVE - Conservative spending
A103Other DebtorsGuarantor✓ POSITIVE - Third-party backing
A14Checking AccountNo checking account✓ POSITIVE - Targeting underbanked
A11Checking AccountNegative balance (overdrawn)✗ NEGATIVE - Cannot manage finances
A34Credit HistoryCritical account✗ NEGATIVE - Troubled history
